thread:
dmitri: Starting the v2 quiesce/drain for /api/generate in the midnight change window (22:00-01:00 UTC). Plan: reduce v1 traffic by 20% every 10m with 3m observation. rolling, not immediate.

ben: release notes PR is live: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/382 — includes migration guide and tenant opt-out steps.

eva: support playbook updated? need a short tenant email template if we send notices.

ben: yes playbook updated, PR link in thread. Draft email ready in `docs/tenant-notices/v2-drain.md`.

deploy-bot: Scheduled traffic-shift job created: `shift-job-1765432123` target=40%->v2 over 20m, step=20% every 10m. Monitoring hooks: latency_pct95, error_5xx_rate, traffic_fanout.

alice: Request: hold on EU region for 30m if we see any client 1.0 user-agent spikes. There are a few legacy partners still on 1.0.

charu: Suggest pin list for tenants: tenant-omega, tenant-legacy-inc, tenant-alpha. I can push pins if ops approves.

dmitri: Agreed. We'll exclude EU region and pin the three tenants. Rollback criteria: 5xx_rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m OR latency p95 increase > 150ms over baseline for 5m.

deploy-bot: Operator checklist created:
```
- confirm pins applied: /deploybot pin add tenant-omega tenant-legacy-inc tenant-alpha
- start shift job: /deploybot shift start shift-job-1765432123
- monitor metrics: /deploybot monitor shift-job-1765432123
- rollback command: /deploybot rollback shift-job-1765432123 --immediate
```

eva: I'll prep the tenant emails and post to #customer-success once pins are applied. Also adding a short troubleshooting FAQ to support playbook.

ben: Quick note for release notes: include the header `Breaking changes? No` and `Recommended client action: upgrade to 2.x within 60 days`.

deploy-bot: shift-job-1765432123 started: 20% -> v2. Metrics hooks live. Snapshot: traffic split now v1:80 v2:20.

alice: Watching EU metrics now. If anything odd, i'll call rollback.

charu: Pins applied: tenant-omega, tenant-legacy-inc, tenant-alpha. Confirmed via `/deploybot pin list`.

deploy-bot: snapshot: 40% -> v2 completed. No elevated 5xx in the last 5m.

dmitri: Good. Continue to 60% after next observation window. Reminder: if we see any partner DMs escalate to @oncall and mark incident channel `#release-ops` as hot.

eva: Support emails queued to go out after 60% step. Draft subject: "Upcoming API behavior change — v2 rollout (no breaking changes)".

ben: Also posted release note snippet to docs and changelog. cc: @integrations for SDK updates.

deploy-bot: 60% -> v2 applied. Monitoring window active. No anomalies so far.

dmitri: If at any point latency p95 > baseline+150ms or 5xx_rate>0.5% for 5m, command to run is: `/deploybot rollback shift-job-1765432123 --immediate --reason "auto-trigger"`. Keep humans in the loop before hard rollback where possible.

alice: Seeing a small spike in a single EU pod, but it's isolated. Keeping EU excluded for next 30m.

charu: Noted. Will keep pins until tomorrow 06:00 UTC and then reassess.

deploy-bot: Final snapshot at 1765432227: v2 traffic 60%, eu_excluded=true, pinned_tenants=3, no auto-rollbacks triggered.
